thread:
Mira Patel: heads up — saw a spike of 400s from legacy clients after yesterday's v2 rollout. looks like seq_len enforcement is rejecting requests with no explicit max_seq. example request headers we saw: 
```http
POST /v2/generate
Host: api.redwood.ai
X-Client-Version: 1.0.3
Content-Length: 1234
```

Jonah Kim: repro on canary or prod? any stack traces? :eyes:

Mira Patel: repro on canary and a handful of tenants in prod. server returns 400: "sequence length exceeds model max", then our routing layer falls back to v1. but quota meter increments on the initial attempt AND the fallback attempt — customers end up seeing doubled token counts. :grimacing:

Luis Ortega: wait — fallback should be a redirect/opaque proxy, not a full counted retry. is the fallback doing a full retry or proxying?

Priya Singh: it does an internal retry to a compatible variant. quota accounting currently happens at ingress before routing decision. that's the root cause.

Jonah Kim: two options quick: 1) move quota accounting to after routing decision, or 2) mark internal retries with a flag so meters ignore them. moving accounting later could mess with rate-limiting though. :thinking:

Mira Patel: short term I added a console flag draft `ingress.skip_retry_on_mismatch` that disables internal retries for affected cohorts. need ops sign-off. also propose adding a probe header `X-Routing-Replay: 1` so telemetry can detect these flows.

Priya Singh: telemetry action: emit trace tags `retry_variant` and `quota_counted=true/false` and sample the traces when `X-Routing-Replay` is present. that will let us backfill which tenants were hit. I'll open a PR for the trace fields and sampling rules.

Luis Ortega: caution: if we move quota later, rate-limit enforcement may be bypassed temporarily. we need a hybrid — keep rate-limit pre-routing but turn off token/quota decrements for internal retries.

Jonah Kim: agreed. short-term patch: set retries=0 for tokens where `X-Client-Version` < `1.5` (legacy SDKs). medium-term: change retry behavior to return a 409 conflict with guidance text that suggests client update or explicit `max_seq`.

Mira Patel: can we scope the console flag to tenants whose grace windows are active? i.e., only disable retries for tenants that crossed >3 seqlen errors/min in the last 10m. I'll open the rollout ticket and include the tenant whitelist.

Priya Singh: I'll tune telemetry sampling — start with 10% for flagged tenants, escalate if we need more signal. will include dashboard panels for `billing.quota_meters.retries` and `ingress.seqlen_errors`. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: deploy queued for patch `ingress/skip_retry_v1hotfix` — ETA 2026-03-21T18:00:00Z

Jonah Kim: after deploy, watch `billing.quota_meters.retries` and `billing.duplicate_quota_events` — set an alert if either >10/min. thanks all, let's coordinate on the rollout ticket (Mira will own).

Mira Patel: noted. I'll post the rollout ticket link here when created and include a short runbook for rollback (flip `ingress.skip_retry_on_mismatch` -> false).
